description: Client-side script for the Leave Application form in ERPNext, handling form setup, validation, dashboard rendering, and interactions with leave data.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Leave Application form, setting query filters.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Actions to perform when form loads, including setting default dates and approval requirements.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form data, especially half-day leave logic.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Builds the leave allocation dashboard based on employee data.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form state, triggers calculations, and sets default values.

methods.name: employee
methods.description: Handles changes to the employee field, updating dashboard and leave balance.

methods.name: leave_approver
methods.description: Updates leave approver name when leave approver is selected.

methods.name: leave_type
methods.description: Updates leave balance when leave type changes.

methods.name: half_day
methods.description: Handles half-day leave selection and date setting.

methods.name: from_date
methods.description: Updates dashboard and date pickers when start date changes.

methods.name: to_date
methods.description: Updates date pickers and total days when end date changes.

methods.name: half_day_date
methods.description: Recalculates total days when half-day date changes.

methods.name: half_day_datepicker
methods.description: Configures the date picker for half-day date with min/max constraints.

methods.name: get_leave_balance
methods.description: Fetches current leave balance for the employee and leave type.

methods.name: calculate_total_days
methods.description: Calculates total leave days, including holidays, via server call.

methods.name: set_leave_approver
methods.description: Automatically sets leave approver based on employee.
